general.description:
A planetwide ocean with many islands clusters and a single large continent, Irilia-11 is a renowned source of quality seafood in the Rith Sphere and even beyond. Also, most of its indigenous ecosystems are largely biocompatible with the needs of all sentient species, and fit for making generic food.
Its mountains' ore is also highly valuable, largely making for the quasi-absence of ore-rich asteroids in the system.
